view.feedbackNone: Pick P and S on at least three stations, then drag the epicenter marker to where the circles meet.
view.feedbackReady: Press Check when the marker sits where the circles meet.
view.feedbackGood: Excellent — within {{distance}} km of the USGS epicenter.
view.feedbackFair: Close — {{distance}} km from the USGS epicenter. Refine your picks.
view.feedbackFar: Not yet — {{distance}} km away. Check your S picks and the circle crossing.
view.bestFit: Best fit of your circles: {{distance}} km from the USGS epicenter.
view.globalDepthNote: Global distances use the IASP91 curve at the catalog depth ({{depth}} km).

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows six real seismograms from stations near an earthquake, stacked by station, and a map of the stations. Each seismogram has a P and an S arrival marker.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you choose an earthquake, show the horizontal component, change the crustal P and S wave speeds, check your epicenter, reveal the answer, and reset.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Move each P marker to the first arrival and each S marker to the larger second arrival. Each S minus P time draws a distance circle around its station.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows six real seismograms recorded thousands of kilometres from a large earthquake, a world map of the stations, and the P and S travel-time curves.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you choose an earthquake, show the horizontal component, show the travel-time curves, check your epicenter, reveal the answer, and reset.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Pick the P and S arrivals on each record. The travel-time curve turns each S minus P time into a distance circle on the globe.

controls.markerHelp: Use the left and right arrow keys to move the marker. Hold Shift for fine steps.
controls.distanceResponse: S minus P is {{interval}} seconds, so station {{station}} is about {{distance}} kilometres from the epicenter.
controls.epicenterHelp: Use the arrow keys to move the marker on the map. Hold Shift for fine steps.
